propertyMappings.description: Shape of the crop. Circle masks the corners.
Locks the crop proportions. Free lets the user resize freely.
Runs each time the crop is auto-applied to the image attribute.

Maximum on-screen width of the crop area. The image scales down to fit; the canvas wraps the rendered image, so smaller crops produce a smaller canvas with no blank gaps. Does not change the saved image size.

Maximum on-screen height of the crop area. The image scales down to fit; the canvas wraps the rendered image, so smaller crops produce a smaller canvas with no blank gaps. Does not change the saved image size.
Let the user resize the selection by dragging its corners.
Show rotate-left / rotate-right buttons. The rotation is baked into the saved image.
Show a grayscale toggle. When on, the saved image is converted to grayscale (black and white).
Show a Reset button that restores the original image and clears zoom, rotation, and crop.
Master switch for zooming. When off, the slider and mouse-wheel zoom are disabled and the image stays at 1×.
Show the zoom slider below the crop area. Turn off to keep mouse-wheel zoom while hiding the slider.
Whether the mouse wheel zooms the image. "On (hold Ctrl)" keeps page scroll working.
Smallest zoom level. 1 = image fits the canvas. Below 1 lets the user zoom out further.
Largest zoom level. 4 means up to 4× the canvas size. Must be greater than Minimum zoom.
Visible text and tooltip for the grayscale toggle.
Visible text and tooltip for the reset button.
Visible label for the zoom slider.
Shown when no image is bound to the image attribute.
Accessible name and tooltip for the rotate-left button.
Accessible name and tooltip for the rotate-right button.
Accessible name for the grayscale toggle (announced by screen readers).
Accessible name for the reset button (announced by screen readers).
Accessible name for the zoom slider (announced by screen readers).
File format. PNG keeps transparency; JPEG produces smaller files.
JPEG compression. Higher = sharper and larger. Ignored for PNG.
Resolution of the saved crop. Original is sharpest; Viewport matches the on-screen canvas size.
